messages:
infra-bot: INCIDENT 2290001111 — gpu-pool-depletion detected in us-west-2. 5xx spike + request latency increase. Pager: on-call.
alex: acked — i'm on it. pulling queue metrics now.
maya: seeing sustained enqueue growth on inference-queue-usw2, ~87% GPU utilization across pools. customers with heavy streams affected.
alex: running quick health check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=pool=usw2`
alex: logs show repeated OOM/evictions on several pods: `OOMKilled` and preemptions from provider.
sam: autoscaler reported 0 new nodes added for 22m due to quota errors: `quotaExceeded: requested 8, available 0`
lin: confirmed — aws spot quota for p4d in us-west-2 was exhausted; autoscaler retried but provider returned 403 on request.
alex: mitigations: (1) shift lower-priority traffic to us-east-1 (2) scale up a dedicated emergency pool in us-east-1 (3) activate model-fallback to quantized-small for non-critical routes.
maya: @sam can you open the quick-evac job to move non-urgent queues? I can run traffic split.
sam: opening quick-evac job now: `./bin/evacuate-queues --from=us-west-2 --to=us-east-1 --tag=noncritical`
jordan: CS update — two customers reported errors in last 20m; one reported degraded latency causing pipeline retries. Flagged for priority outreach.
kate: will notify account execs for any customers above $50k MRR.
lin: note: automatic fallback to quantized model increased p50 latency but kept error rate down. good short-term tradeoff.
alex: temporary traffic plan applied: 60% routed to us-east-1, 40% remains in us-west-2 for critical low-latency customers pinned to dedicated pools.
maya: started emergency dedicated pool in us-east-1 (g5x2 reserved) — bootstrapping models. ETA ~7m.
sam: autoscaler logs: `scale request failed - providerQuotaExceeded`. filed cloud ticket with provider: CT-90812.
alex: manual capacity bump succeeded for emergency pool (used reserved capacity from spare-account). backfilling requests.
jordan: sent customer notification template: "We're experiencing reduced capacity in us-west-2; some requests may be routed to another region and you may see higher latencies. We're prioritizing critical traffic."
kate: adding incident severity: Sev2 (partial outage, customer impact).
lin: discovered root cause candidate: spike in long-running streaming jobs + recent autoscaler change that reduced max-burst-factor. creating a repro.
maya: handing off to night on-call: @sam — please continue monitoring queue depth and autoscaler retries. I'll remain reachable for escalation.
sam: acknowledged handoff. setting alerts tighter: queue-depth > 100 -> page.
alex: action items captured: JIRA INF-4983 (emergency pool provisioning postmortem), INF-4984 (autoscaler retry/backoff fix), INF-4985 (quota-monitoring alert), INF-4986 (billing/customer-communication followup). linking below.

---

alex: quick troubleshooting snippet for the log we saw:
```
2026-02-18T22:10:03Z pod/inference-xyz OOMKilled
2026-02-18T22:10:07Z autoscaler: request failed: QuotaExceededError: requested 8 GPUs, available 0
```

lin: note on mitigation decisions: we chose traffic shift + quantized fallback to avoid global failover and preserve critical SLAs.

maya: small update — emergency pool in us-east-1 reached steady state; error rates dropping back toward baseline.

sam: autoscaler retry fix applied to staging; will push a hotfix to prod tomorrow AM if green.

jordan: CS outreach summary: 3 affected customers identified, 1 escalated to priority support. all notified.

kate: scheduling post-incident review: proposed 2026-02-20 16:00 UTC. owners: alex (incident lead), lin (root cause), sam (autoscaler), maya (mitigation ops).

alex: agreed. setting calendar invite and prep doc. assigning notes owner: lin.

lin: initial RCA hypothesis: a confluence of quota exhaustion for spot GPUs + an autoscaler regression that reduced burst capacity under unusual job length distribution. will confirm with traces.

sam: interim control: revert autoscaler max-burst-factor to previous value; patch to improve error handling for provider quota responses.

maya: action items (short):
- INF-4984 assign sam: add robust backoff & quota-detection (due 2026-03-05)
- INF-4985 assign alex: add quota usage dashboard + alert (due 2026-02-27)
- INF-4986 assign jordan: customer follow-ups + CS postmortem notes (due 2026-02-25)
- INF-4983 assign lin: postmortem doc + RCA (due 2026-02-22)

alex: tagging owners in JIRA and Slack. please update ticket when work starts.

kate: closing incident channel when stabilized. leave this thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

sam: monitoring shows queue depth back to normal, error rate trending down. I'll keep 15m checks for next 6 hours.

alex: incident resolved — shifting to follow-up mode. severity downgraded to Sev3 for ongoing RCA.

lin: I'll post initial RCA draft in the postmortem doc by tomorrow morning.

jordan: final CS note: notified customers that we've stabilized and will provide a follow-up RCA.

kate: thanks all — good work moving quickly. we'll discuss in PIR. :clap:
